sentences.text: The current RBI directions in force for this UCB say pre-payment charge is permitted only as per the stated conditions, and in cases outside the specific covered paragraphs any pre-payment charge, if any, must be as per the approved policy of the UCB. [E5][E6][R6][R8]
The Home Loan Agreement itself states a 2% pre-payment charge on the principal outstanding on pre-payment or foreclosure. [E1][E2]

I cannot confirm that this 2% charge complies with the current RBI rule set from the evidence provided, because the applicability of the specific no-prepayment-charge rule depends on the loan rate type, which is not shown here. [R7]
The withdrawn 2014 and 2025 RBI pre-payment charge directions are no longer in force on the as-of date, so they do not control this case. [R1][R4]

missing.searched: searched the loan documents and rule findings for whether the home loan is floating rate or another rate type; only a rate-type-dependent prepayment rule was found, but the rate type itself was not in the evidence.
